selection_basis.rule: Inspect the exact printed passages cited by the accepted audit, including their full page context and publication title pages.
selection_basis.prior_exposure: The mediated quotations and 2016 interpretation were already read; this is a disclosed documentary inspection, not blind evaluation.

sources.title: A True & Faithful Relation of what passed for many yeers between Dr. John Dee and some spirits
sources.imprint: London, printed by D. Maxwell for T. Garthwait

sources.title: The Works of Sir Thomas Browne, Volume III

records.locator: Memorandum at bottom of printed 447, continued at top of 448 before the 1587 action heading
observations: The Latin memorandum names Pucci and presents 800 florins and 630 ducats in the context of disputed money and avoiding accusations.
Its continuation recounts a witnessed settlement and a signed acknowledgement, naming 800 florins and also describing 2,000 ducats and more than 400 Doleri on the table.
The 1587 heading below the continuation starts another entry; it is not substituted for the memorandum’s printed date.
records.interpretation: A dispute/settlement narrative; the selected passage does not identify a Voynich-book sale or trace the 630 ducats to a 600-ducat payment.
limits: No source of every coin established
No full Latin transcription or translation supplied
Printed edition inspected, not Dee’s autograph

records.locator: Sir Thomas Browne to Mr. Elias Ashmole, ending before the following letter to John Aubrey
observations: Browne reports what Arthur Dee told him about a book found alongside alchemical powder and his father’s unsuccessful efforts to understand it.
The edited text closes with (No Signature.).
The two page running heads show 1674 and 1672-3; these are not treated as a dateline or assigned exact letter date.
records.interpretation: Reported testimony about an unidentified book, without an image, physical description or unique manuscript identifier sufficient to establish MS 408.
limits: Date not inferred solely from running heads
Reported alchemical transmutation not adopted as an observed event
Historical hieroglyphicks wording not converted to an identified script

evidence_status.DPF003: Cited 1852 printed passage now directly inspected in this follow-up; original letter remains uninspected.
evidence_status.DPF004: Cited 1659 printed memorandum now directly inspected in this follow-up; autograph and monetary source tracing remain uninspected.

method: Byte lengths and SHA-256 pins, Archive metadata SHA-1 matches, publication title inspection and complete rendered cited pages. OCR/text layers locate candidates but do not establish absence or replace visual checks.

reproduction.file_pages_versus_publication_pages: Mappings refer only to these pinned scans; do not calculate a common offset across editions.
